notes.title: Galactic Laws
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

The major new update "[b]Galactic Laws[/b]" is now available.
It adds [u]referendums[/u] to sci-fi scenarios and the possibility to achieve total victory by passing certain laws.

Please report any problems or bugs. Enjoy the game!

[h1]Other news from the franchise[/h1]

The game "[b]Vox Populi: Australia 2025[/b]" will be released soon with new [u]post-apocalyptic[/u] scenarios.

If you are interested in this kind of atypical scenario, don't hesitate to take a look!

[url=store.steampowered.com/app/3539270/Vox_Populi_Australia_2025][img]https://i.ibb.co/bjq2d4Xg/Image-SF-Update.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: V 1.04.01
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

This new minor update focuses on [b]improving the user interface[/b]:

[list][*]Almost all windows can now be closed by clicking outside or using the Escape key.
[*]Almost all windows can now be closed or opened with a keyboard shortcut.
[*]A windowed mode has been added, available via options.
[*]Other minor additions and fixes[/list]
[b]In addition, the AI has been rebalanced[/b] so that Democrats and Republicans no longer win 100% of the 538 seats as quickly and easily in the first two scenarios. They are still a relatively easy level for players.

If you want to load a former save, you'll have to go back to the old version.

Please report any bugs or issues.

notes.title: Vox Populi: USA 2024 - Release
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

The political strategy game '[b]Vox Populi: USA 2024[/b]' is now available! Take on the role of one of the candidates in this year's US presidential election, or start one of the [b]seven other fictional scenarios available[/b]!

In addition to the characters and map, there are several new features compared to the other games in the franchise:

[list][*][b]Unique events[/b] linked to real events in the country
[*]A new voting system: the [b]Electoral College[/b], with new [i]Winner-take-all[/i] strategies
[*][b]New referendums[/b] allowing total victory in the [b]Red Wave[/b] and [b]Monarchist Wave[/b] scenarios
[*][b][u]Science fiction scenarios[/u][/b] with their own ideologies, corpuses, character traits, events and regions. You can play as an alien, an advocate of equality between species, or the opposite, of the domination of one species over another.[/list]
Please report any bugs or problems. If you wish, our [u]new Discord server[/u] has just been updated so we can communicate: https://discord.com/invite/N8E5Yc72Ym


[b]See you soon![/b]
